text_block_list.text:
A charity event was being held on academy 
grounds today. Organized primarily by 
students, it was drawing quite a crowd of 
interested visitors.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, everyone! Would you care to enjoy 
some fluffy shaved ice relaxing on a chair 
in the shade?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-san! You came!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And look at these seashell 
accessories. For you, Trainer-san, I think 
this pen holder or the perpetual calendar 
would be very handy!
choice_data_list: The pen holder design is really intricate!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's...... I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Actually, that was Cheval-san's idea! She 
suggested we paint them ourselves to 
create stylish pen holders people would 
love to buy!
choice_data_list:
The menu board looks just like a beach hut 
sign, too.

The menu board looks just like a beach hut 
sign, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That was Cheval-san's idea as well. Plus, 
since it hangs up high and could be 
dangerous if it fell, she even prepared 
lightweight materials for it.

Customers stopped by Satono Diamond and 
the others' booth one after another, 
bustling with energy. The excitement 
showed no signs of stopping...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The end of the line is over here! We 
apologize for the wait, but it's currently 
about a 20-minute wait from the back of 
the line!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Mommy, how much longer~? My legs are 
getting tired~.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...20 minutes is a long time just to get 
shaved ice. Some people are even giving up 
on waiting in line...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The customers seem to be getting bored... 
Even though they came all the way here to 
see us...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Bored... Maybe if there was something to 
watch while they waited...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah... That's it, Cheval-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Why don't we put on a mini-live? 
That way, the customers waiting in line 
can be entertained!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Though we still have to keep running the 
shop... Wait, what if we take turns 
performing solo lives...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! That sounds perfect! Now let's 
decide the order of who goes first!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
S-Since I was the one who suggested it... 
I'll go first...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu! Cheval-san!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...E-Everyone waiting in line... W-We're 
terribly sorry to keep you waiting...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-While you w... wait, p-please enjoy our 
mini-live!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We'll be adjusting the queue layout! To 
make it easier for everyone to watch, 
please line up in two rows alongside the 
shop!

Cheers immediately broke out from the long 
line. Satono Diamond and the crew worked 
together seamlessly, managing both the 
booth and the live performances.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Great work, everyone! The chairwoman gave 
us so much praise!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Also, we received so much feedback... Take 
a look, everyone! We've got a whole 
cardboard box full of survey responses!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, a massive success! I can't believe 
we pulled it off so well...!
choice_data_list:
Maybe your uncompromising dedication 
touched their hearts?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~, a massive success! I can't believe 
we pulled it off so well...!
choice_data_list:
Maybe your uncompromising dedication 
touched their hearts?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. If Dia-san hadn't been so 
passionate, I probably wouldn't have been 
able to do nearly as much.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to passion, I won't lose to 
anyone! ...Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
... It was only because everyone was here 
that we could make the shop so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because everyone gave it their all 
and saw it through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Just look at Cheval-san's face! Look how 
proud and shining she is!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: !? N-No... That's not...!

The horse girls who had banded together 
until today, and the driving force behind 
them. Their innocent laughter resonated 
softly into the sunset sky.
